fusions.name: Quarry Mark
fusions.desc: A swift blow that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance of [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Stretch
fusions.desc: Hurls a boulder that deals 24 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 9 tiles. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Narrowing Gap
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 6%.
